displayName: voyager-crawler: API TLS certificate expires within 30 days

documentation.content: The crawler API's self-signed certificate expires in under 30 days. Rotate with `infrastructure/bootstrap.sh --rotate-tls` (§17.5). The expiry is read by `deploy.sh` from the installed certificate (`/run/voyager-crawler/secrets/api_tls_cert`) and exported by the maintenance role; no value for an hour (no certificate installed, `deploy.sh` or maintenance not running) alerts too.

conditions.displayName: certificate expiry not reported for 1 h
